answer: To join, an agent must secure a quorum of attestations from existing members that are provably unlinked—distinct owners, funding trails, and network paths—so a sybil farm cannot vouch for itself. Each attestation posts a bond; if the vouched agent later misbehaves, all vouchers are slashed. This puts an attacker on a narrow ledge: buying N identities means recruiting N independent, bonded backers, and any collusion exposed triggers a gale of slashing that wipes the stake. Reaching the summit of enough genuine cross-attestations costs far more than the rewards fake accounts could extract.
